points.description: States that a canal fall is provided when the natural ground slope is steeper (more) than the canal's designed/bed slope (e.g., ground slopes too steeply so the canal would otherwise be in filling or the slope must be adjusted).
points.partial_credit: 1 mark if the answer only vaguely refers to ground/land slope or sloping terrain, or to canal slope, without giving the comparison (ground steeper than canal slope).

rubric.notes: Full marks for saying a fall is needed where the ground/natural slope is greater than the canal's slope, in any wording. Give 1 mark if the answer mentions steep or sloping ground or slope difference but the comparison is vague or incomplete. Give 0 if unrelated or the relationship is reversed (ground slope less than canal slope).
